title: Synthesis and cytotoxicity evaluation of novel 1,8-acridinedione derivatives bearing phthalimide moiety as potential antitumor agents.
authors: Khatab, Hassan A; Hammad, Sherif F; El-Fakharany, Esmail M; Hashem, Ahmed I; El-Helw, Eman A E
one_liner_zh: 该文合成并评估含邻苯二甲酰亚胺的吖啶二酮衍生物的抗肿瘤活性，涉及小分子-蛋白对接，但对象为药物-激酶/肿瘤相关蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: In this study, we aimed to develop hybrid antitumor compounds by synthesizing and characterizing novel N-substituted acrididine-1,8-dione derivatives, designed as hybrids of phthalimide and acridine-1,8-diones. We employed a three-step synthetic strategy and characterized all compounds using IR, (1)H NMR, (13)C NMR, and LC-MS. The cytotoxicity and antitumor activity of five compounds (8c, 8f, 8h, 8i, and 8L) against four cancer cell lines (H460, A431, A549, and MDA-MB-231) compared to human skin fibroblast cells were evaluated. Among the synthesized compounds, compound 8f showed promising activity against skin and lung cancers, with favorable IC(50) values and selectivity index. The relative changes in mRNA expression levels of four key genes (p53, TOP2B, p38, and EGFR) in A431 cells treated with the five synthesized compounds (8c, 8f, 8h, 8i, and 8L) were also investigated. Additionally, molecular docking studies revealed that compound 8f exhibited high binding affinity with TOP2B, p38, p53, and EGFR, suggesting its potential as a targeted anticancer therapy. The results obtained indicate that N-substituted acrididine-1,8-dione derivatives have the potential to be developed as novel antitumor agents with a dual mechanism of action, and compound 8f is a promising candidate for further investigation.
abstract_zh: 在本研究中，我们旨在通过合成并表征新型N-取代吖啶-1,8-二酮衍生物，开发杂交抗肿瘤化合物，这些衍生物设计为邻苯二甲酰亚胺和吖啶-1,8-二酮的杂交体。我们采用三步合成策略，并使用IR、¹H NMR、¹³C NMR和LC-MS对所有化合物进行了表征。评估了五种化合物（8c、8f、8h、8i和8L）对四种癌细胞系（H460、A431、A549和MDA-MB-231）与人皮肤成纤维细胞相比的细胞毒性和抗肿瘤活性。在合成的化合物中，化合物8f对皮肤癌和肺癌显示出有前景的活性，具有有利的IC(50)值和选择性指数。我们还研究了用五种合成化合物（8c、8f、8h、8i和8L）处理的A431细胞中四个关键基因（p53、TOP2B、p38和EGFR）mRNA表达水平的相对变化。此外，分子对接研究显示，化合物8f与TOP2B、p38、p53和EGFR表现出高结合亲和力，表明其作为靶向抗癌治疗的潜力。所得结果表明，N-取代吖啶-1,8-二酮衍生物有潜力被开发为具有双重作用机制的新型抗肿瘤药物，且化合物8f是进一步研究的有前景候选物。
